info.name: Present payin on a registered device

items.docs:
Present a payin for processing on a registered device using a payin configuration. The merchant status must be `ACTIVE` to process a payin.

> 📘 Note
>
> A payment method created on a registered device may only be used for payins within the same merchant for which it was collected.

info.name: Present payment method on a registered device

items.docs:
Create a payment method on a registered device using a payment method configuration. The merchant status must be `ACTIVE` to create a payment method.

> 📘 Note
>
> A payment method created on a registered device may only be used for payins within the same merchant for which it was collected.

Best effort attempt to cancel currently presented payin or payment method on device. This does not guarantee the presented entity can be canceled on the device. If the payin begins processing before it can be canceled, then you will need to void the payin if it processes. A corresponding webhook will trigger if the presented payin or payment method is canceled or processes.

If no payin or payment method is being presented at the time of the request, a `202 Accepted` response will be returned.

Only available in the Rainforest sandbox environment.

After presenting a payin or payment method on a virtual device this endpoint is available to move on from the `PRESENTING` status to a desired subsequent status.

The expected webhook will be sent for the payin or payment method on status change.
